description.value: Mariner's Loft is a complex of seven spacious ocean-view vacation rental condos perched above Ganges Harbour on Salt Spring Island. Units are two- and three-bedroom with full kitchens, in-suite laundry, and self-check-in, located in the walkable heart of Ganges village near shops, restaurants, and the famous Saturday Market. Select suites are dog-friendly, and the property offers private parking.

address.value: 118 Rainbow Road, Salt Spring Island, BC, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Mariner's Loft is a complex of seven self-check-in vacation rental condos above Ganges Harbour on Salt Spring Island. The website describes the location as 'in the heart of the village' with restaurants nearby, supporting nearby evening food. Neither required criterion (secure bike storage or staff bike knowledge) is mentioned anywhere, and the self-check-in model means there may be no on-site staff at all. The OSM community is listed as Duncan, but the property is clearly on Salt Spring Island.
